title: T0: l_bracket panels — 2D→3D→2D grid roundtrip within budget, panel identity preserved

oracles.$semantics: For every panel, every grid point: |map3d→2d(map2d→3d(p)) − p| ≤ budget AND the returning panel_id equals the originating panel (identity mismatch = association-swap defect, scored as a huge residual).
